research.facts:
Class of 2028 — In-Person Window Opens TODAY
**Source 1 (PRIMARY):** NCAA recruiting calendar / sportsrecruits.com / ncsasports.org
- In-person contact window for Class of 2028 (entering junior year fall 2026) opens September 9, 2026 at 7 AM ET
- Coaches can make in-person contact at schools, homes, and approved locations
- Separate from September 1 verbal/phone contact window which opened earlier
- **Confidence: HIGH** (confirmed from multiple recruiting rule sources)
**Source 2:** SoftballAmerica / Line Drive Media
- September 1 first-contact window opened for Class of 2028 — first calls going out
- September 9 at 7 AM ET = in-person window
- Peyton Ushery committed to Georgia (No. 2 Line Drive Media HOT 100) on September 1 — first major D1 commit of the class
- Record 1,226 EIS nominations for this class
- **Confidence: HIGH** (consistent with all pipeline tracking since Aug 19)
**Freshness Justification:** TODAY is the day — this is the event, not a preview.

research.facts:
USA WNT Group Oklahoma — Three Days Out
**Source 1:** wbsc.org
- Tournament: WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Group Stage, Oklahoma City (Group Oklahoma)
- Dates: September 12–16, 2026
- Venue: Devon Park (OGE Energy Field), Oklahoma City
- Format: 6-team round-robin + play-offs on Sept. 16
- USA vs No. 7 Mexico — opening night Sept. 12, 7:30 PM (Opening Ceremony 6:30 PM)
- Netherlands No. 6, China No. 8, Brazil No. 17, New Zealand No. 23
- Top 2 advance to 2027 WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Finals, Redcliffe, Queensland (April 5–11, 2027)
- Sept. 16 play-off format: 1st vs 2nd at 1:00 PM (both advance); 3rd vs 4th at 4:00 PM; Repechage at 7:00 PM
- **Confidence: HIGH** (wbsc.org official)
**Source 2:** usasoftball.com / soonersports.com
- 16-player roster announced
- Rachel Garcia — 2020 Olympic gold medalist
- Dejah Mulipola — 2020 Olympic gold medalist
- 7 members competed on 2025 World Games gold-medal team
- 10 players made 2025 Down Under Series
- Coaching staff: Patty Gasso (HC), JT Gasso, Jennifer Rocha
- USA went 5-0 at International Cup at same Devon Park venue
- **Confidence: HIGH** (official announcement)
**Freshness Justification:** 3 days out — critical countdown window for audience engagement.
